BURHAN:v1p211/r6.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p211/r6.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
BURHAN:v1p211/r6.claim: A report from Samura says the Qur'an was revealed in three modes; Abu Ubayd says reports for seven are mutawatir apart from this report.
BURHAN:v1p211/r6.anchor: ما رواه الحاكم فى المستدرك عن سمرة يرفعه أنزل القرآن على ثلاثة أحرف فقال أبو عبيد تواترت الأخبار بالسبعة إلا هذا الحديث

BURHAN:v1p211/r7.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p211/r7.speaker: أبو شامة
BURHAN:v1p211/r7.claim: Abu Shama suggests the three-mode report refers either to some words with three accepted forms or to an initial revelation in three modes later expanded to seven.
BURHAN:v1p211/r7.anchor: قال أبو شامة يحتمل أن يكون معناه إن بعضه أنزل على ثلاثة أحرف كحذره والرهب والصدق

BURHAN:v1p211/r8.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p211/r8.speaker: author
BURHAN:v1p211/r8.claim: The seven modes include material read in two, three, or more forms up to seven, easing recitation through differing languages and synonymous or near-synonymous expressions.
BURHAN:v1p211/r8.anchor: ومعنى جميع ذلك أنه نزل منه ما يقرأ على حرفين وعلى ثلاثة وأكثر إلى سبعة أحرف توسعة على العباد باعتبار اختلاف اللغات

BURHAN:v3p70#2/r5.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v3p70#2/r5.speaker: حازم
BURHAN:v3p70#2/r5.claim: Hazim says أصبح is not extra when the described state also held the previous evening, but is extra otherwise, as in saying that honey became sweet.
BURHAN:v3p70#2/r5.anchor: قال حازم إن كان الأمر الذي ذكر أنه فيه اصبح يكن أمسى فيه فليست زائدة وإلا فهي زائدة

BURHAN:v3p70#2/r6.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v3p70#2/r6.speaker: الرماني
BURHAN:v3p70#2/r6.claim: Al-Rummani rejects treating أصبح as extra here: sufferers hope for morning relief after worsening at night, so the word marks the time their loss became clear.
BURHAN:v3p70#2/r6.anchor: وأجاب الرماني عن قوله ﴿ فأصبحوا خاسرين ﴾ 4 فإن العادة أن من به علة تزاد عليه بالليل

ITQAN:v2p429/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v2p429/r3.speaker: author
ITQAN:v2p429/r3.claim: When annexed, أحد can mean “the first/one of the two,” as in the prisoner's dream interpretation.
ITQAN:v2p429/r3.anchor: والثاني المستعمل مضافا إليه بمعنى الأول نحو

ITQAN:v4p347/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v4p347/r6.speaker: جعفر بن شمس الخلافة
ITQAN:v4p347/r6.claim: Ja'far lists this Qur'anic clause among expressions used proverbially (irsāl al-mathal).
ITQAN:v4p347/r6.anchor: عقد جعفر بن شمس الخلافة في كتاب الآداب بابا في ألفاظ من القرآن جارية مجرى المثل

DAMGHANI:v1p383/r8.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p383/r8.speaker: author
DAMGHANI:v1p383/r8.claim: Qaḍā can mean becoming due or settled; the matter in the prison interpretation has been decided.
DAMGHANI:v1p383/r8.anchor: السادس : قضى بمعنى وجب قوله تعالى في سورة يوسف

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r1.claim: Qaḍā can mean completion, as in the completion of a set term or period.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r1.anchor: والسابع : التمام . ومنه قوله تعالى في الأنعام : ﴿ ثم يبعثكم فيه ليقضى أجل مسمى ﴾

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r2.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r2.claim: An eighth sense is deciding or settling a dispute between parties.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r2.anchor: والثامن : الفصل . ومنه قوله تعالى في الأنعام : ﴿ لقضي الأمر بيني وبينكم ﴾

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r3.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r3.claim: A ninth sense is creating or forming, as in God's making the seven heavens.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r3.anchor: والتاسع : الخلق . ومنه [ قوله ] تعالى في حم السجدة : ﴿ فقضاهن سبع سماوات في يومين ﴾

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r4.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r4.claim: A tenth sense is something irrevocably determined or decreed; the scoped verse uses this sense.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r4.anchor: والعاشر : الحتم . ومنه قوله تعالى [ في يوسف ] : ﴿ قضي الأمر الذي فيه تستفتيان ﴾

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r5.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r5.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r5.claim: An eleventh expression is “the slaughtering of death,” cited in the announcement of the Day of Regret.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r5.anchor: والحادي عشر : ذبح الموت . ومنه قوله تعالى في مريم : ﴿ وأنذرهم يوم الحسرة إذ قضي الأمر ﴾

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r6.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r6.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r6.claim: A twelfth expression describes Hell's gates being closed upon its inhabitants after the matter is settled.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r6.anchor: والثاني عشر : اغلاق أبواب جهنم على أهلها . ومنه قوله تعالى في إبراهيم : ﴿ وقال الشيطان لما قضي الأمر ﴾

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r7.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r7.speaker: مقاتل
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r7.claim: A thirteenth sense is making a covenant; Muqatil glosses God's instruction to Lot as a covenant concerning punishment.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r7.anchor: والثالث عشر : العهد . ومنه قوله تعالى في الحجر : ﴿ وقضينا إليه ذلك الأمر ﴾ ، قال مقاتل : عهدنا إلى لوط أمر العذاب

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r8.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r8.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r8.claim: A fourteenth sense is a ruling or judgment.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r8.anchor: والرابع عشر : الحكم . ومنه قوله تعالى في سورة النساء : ﴿ ثم لا يجدوا في أنفسهم حرجا مما قضيت ﴾

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r9.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r9.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r9.claim: A fifteenth sense is a testament or command given to Moses.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p508/r9.anchor: والخامس عشر : الوصية . ومنه قوله تعالى في القصص : ﴿ وما كنت بجانب الغربي إذ قضينا إلى موسى الأمر

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r1.claim: One sense of al-amr is the killing of Qurayza's men and the expulsion of Nadir's people, associated here with the command to pardon until God's decree comes.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r1.anchor: والسادس : قتل بني قريظة وجلاء بني النضير . ومنه قوله تعالى في البقرة : ﴿ فاعفوا واصفحوا حتى يأتي الله بأمره ﴾

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r2.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r2.claim: Another sense is the Resurrection, as in the declaration that God's command has come.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r2.anchor: والسابع : القيامة . ومنه قوله تعالى في النحل : ﴿ أتى أمر الله فلا تستعجلوه ﴾

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r3.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r3.claim: A further sense is divine governance or decree, as in God's managing affairs and making signs clear.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r3.anchor: والثامن : القضاء . ومنه قوله تعالى في الأعراف : ﴿ ألا له الخلق والأمر ﴾ ، وفي يونس : ﴿ يدبر الأمر ما من شفيع إلا من بعد إذنه ﴾

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r4.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r4.claim: Al-amr can mean revelation sent from heaven to earth or descending among the heavens.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r4.anchor: والتاسع : الوحي . ومنه قوله تعالى في تنزيل السجدة : ﴿ يدبر الأمر من السماء إلى الأرض ﴾ ، وفي الطلاق : ﴿ يتنزل الأمر بينهن ﴾

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r5.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r5.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r5.claim: Another sense is victory or success, as discussed in the question whether believers have any share in the matter.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r5.anchor: والعاشر : النصر . ومنه قوله تعالى في آل عمران : ^ ( يقولون هل لنا من الأمر من شيء قل إن الأمر كله لله ) ^

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r6.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r6.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r6.claim: Al-amr can mean a sin and its adverse consequence.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r6.anchor: والحادي عشر : الذنب . ومنه قوله تعالى في المائدة : ﴿ ليذوق وبال أمره ﴾ . وفي التغابن : ﴿ فذاقوا وبال أمرهم ﴾

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r7.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r7.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r7.claim: A further sense is a matter, state, or condition.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r7.anchor: والثاني عشر : الشأن والحال . ومنه قوله تعالى في هود : ^ ( وما أمر فرعون برشيد ) ^ ، وفي حم عسق : ﴿ ألا إلى الله تصير الأمور ﴾

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r8.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r8.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r8.claim: Al-amr can refer to death, as in the statement that worldly hopes deceived people until God's command arrived.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r8.anchor: والثالث عشر : الموت . ومنه قوله تعالى في الحديد : ﴿ وغرتكم الأماني حتى جاء أمر الله ﴾

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r9.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r9.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r9.claim: A further sense is consultation, as in Pharaoh asking for counsel about Moses.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r9.anchor: والرابع عشر : المشورة . ومنه قوله تعالى في الأعراف : ﴿ يريد أن يخرجكم من أرضكم فماذا تأمرون ﴾

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r10.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r10.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r10.claim: Al-amr can mean caution or precaution, as in the claim that people had prepared themselves for trouble.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r10.anchor: والخامس عشر : الحذر . ومنه قوله تعالى في التوبة : ﴿ وإن تصبك مصيبة يقولوا قد أخذنا أمرنا من قبل ﴾

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r11.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r11.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r11.claim: Another sense is drowning, in Noah's words that none can be protected from God's command except whom He shows mercy.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r11.anchor: السادس عشر : الغرق . ومنه قوله تعالى في هود : ﴿ قال لا عاصم اليوم من أمر الله إلا من رحم ﴾

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r12.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r12.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r12.claim: Al-amr can mean fertility or abundant produce, associated with God's sending victory or a matter from Himself.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r12.anchor: والسابع عشر : الخصب . منه قوله تعالى في المائدة : ﴿ فعسى الله أن يأتي بالفتح أو أمر من عنده ﴾

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r13.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r13.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r13.claim: The eighteenth sense is a command that requests an action, as when God commands people to return trusts or act justly.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p174/r13.anchor: والثامن عشر : الأمر الذي هو استدعاء الفعل . ومنه قوله تعالى في سورة النساء : ﴿ إن الله يأمركم أن تؤدوا الأمانات إلى أهلها ﴾

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p176/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p176/r1.speaker: بعضهم
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p176/r1.claim: Some add a nineteenth sense, abundance: “We commanded its affluent people” is read as “We made them numerous”; others include it under a command to act, namely obedience.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p176/r1.anchor: زاد بعضهم وجها تاسع عشر : فقال : الأمر : الكثرة . ومنه قوله تعالى [ في الإسراء ] : ﴿ وإذا أردنا أن نهلك قرية أمرنا مترفيها ﴾ ، أي : كثرناهم

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r1.speaker: ابن قتيبة
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r1.claim: Ibn Qutayba says mathal can mean likeness, lesson, or description.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r1.anchor: قال ابن قتيبة : المثل : الشبه ، يقال : هذا مثل هذا ومثله ، كما يقال : شبه الشيء وشبهه . والمثل : العبرة . والمثل : الصفة

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r2.speaker: بعض أهل المعاني
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r2.claim: Some specialists define a true pair of equals as two things each standing in for the other and taking its place.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r2.anchor: وقال بعض أهل المعاني : المثل المشابه وحد المثلين ما قام كل واحد منهما مقام صاحبه وسد مسده

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r3.speaker: بعض أهل المعاني
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r3.claim: An illustrative parable need not resemble its subject in essence; it makes the intended meaning clear to the listener.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r3.anchor: وأما المثل فلا يشبه الممثل به في ذاته ، وإنما المقصود منه أن يفهم السامع معنى الممثل بالمثل

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r4.speaker: ثعلب
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r4.claim: Thaʿlab calls proverbs Arab wisdom passed from one person to another without explicit explanation, understood through brevity and concision.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r4.anchor: وقال ثعلب : الأمثال : حكمة العرب كان يوحي بعضهم بها إلى بعض بلا تصريح ، فيفهم الرجل عن صاحبه ما حاول باختصار وايجاز

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r5.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r5.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r5.claim: The purpose of a parable is to clarify the point for which it was offered and make an obscure matter plain.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r5.anchor: واعلم ان فائدة المثل أن تبين للمضروب له الأمر الذي ضرب لأجله فينجلي غامضه

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r6.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r6.speaker: أهل التفسير
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r6.claim: The first Qur'anic face of mathal is likeness or comparison, illustrated by examples of a good word, a gnat, and the Torah bearers.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r6.anchor: أحدها : الشبه . ومنه قوله تعالى في إبراهيم : ﴿ ضرب الله مثلا كلمة طيبة ﴾ ، وفي الحج : ﴿ ضرب مثل فاستمعوا له ﴾

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r7.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r7.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r7.claim: A lexical note distinguishes ḥiṣān for a chaste woman, muḥṣana for a protected woman, and ḥiṣān for a horse described as fortified.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r7.anchor: ويقال : امرأة حصان : بينة الحصانة والحصن : وفرس حصان : بين التحصين

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r8.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r8.speaker: ثعلب
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r8.claim: Thaʿlab says a chaste woman may be called either muḥṣana or muḥṣina, but a married woman is only muḥṣana.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r8.anchor: وسمعت القطان يقول : سمعت ثعلبا يقول : كل امرأة عفيفة فهي محصنة ومحصنة . وكل امرأة متزوجة فهي محصنة لا غير

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r9.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r9.speaker: أهل التفسير
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r9.claim: One Qur'anic sense of al-muḥṣanāt is chaste women, including Mary and women accused of adultery.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r9.anchor: أحدها : العفائف . ومنه قوله تعالى في سورة النساء : ﴿ محصنات غير مسافحات ﴾ ، وفي المائدة : ﴿ محصنين غير مسافحين ﴾

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r10.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r10.speaker: أهل التفسير
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r10.claim: A second Qur'anic sense is free women, in the rulings about marriage and the penalty for enslaved women.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p551/r10.anchor: والثاني : الحرائر . ومنه قوله تعالى في النساء : ﴿ ومن لم يستطع منكم طولا أن ينكح المحصنات المؤمنات ﴾
